goal: Allow local RPC clients and bitcoin-cli to connect over UNIX domain sockets instead of TCP loopback
Let node operators control local RPC access with filesystem permissions rather than IP allowlists
Eliminate TCP networking overhead for local RPC and REST traffic
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Concept and approach approval praising the design choices and socket abstractions (winterrdog)
Concept approval without stated reasons (b-l-u-e, vasild)
Unaddressed objection: functional tests fail on NetBSD due to buffer size limits (winterrdog)
Unresolved objection: functional tests hang on FreeBSD, but author cannot reproduce in VM (winterrdog)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it fulfills a feature request open since 2014 for UNIX domain socket RPC support
Gives node operators standard OS filesystem permission controls instead of IP allowlists
Reduces local connection overhead and cleans up technical debt from earlier socket code
